sections.label: Simultaneous debate on two Motions
sections.summary: A Business Motion moves that the Motions on 'Consideration of Matters Regarding Member of Parliament' and 'Suspension of Member' be debated together, with votes taken separately.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: I am thus moving this Business Motion for a simultaneous debate on the two Motions, so that Members can address both Motions in a single speech.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: To be clear and for avoidance of doubt, it is only the debate that is to be concurrent.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: And at the end of the debate, the votes on the two Motions will be taken separately.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Resolved, "That, notwithstanding the Standing Orders, the Motions on 'Consideration of Matters Regarding Member of Parliament' and 'Suspension of Member' be taken together, and the debate on these Motions and on any amendment proposed thereto be proceeded with simultaneously as though the debate were on a single Motion." –  .
